snippet.title: Seafarer: The Ship Sim - Official The Immersion Update Release Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the Immersion update release trailer for Seafarer: The Ship Sim, a naval simulation game developed by Astragon. Players can now access The Immersion update, which focuses on making Seafarers feel more alive. The update also includes a reworked campaign, a new mission, and new inspection gameplay. The Immersion update for Seafarer: The Ship Sim is available now in Early Access for PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
